title: Jeff Glass - Home Equity Investment at Hometap (EP.418)

reader_summary.headline: Jeff Glass is the Cofounder and CEO of Hometap Equity Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Jeff Glass is the Cofounder and CEO of Hometap Equity Partners. Jeff started the business eight years ago after a series of successes as an entrepreneur followed by seven years investing at Bain Capital Ventures. Our conversation covers Jeff's early lessons in sales, entrepreneurship, and investing that led to the founding of Hometap.

key_points.text: Jeff Glass is the Cofounder and CEO of Hometap Equity Partners.
We then discuss Hometap's investment strategy, including the chicken-and-egg problem of starting the business, sourcing homeowners, sourcing capital, and developing the team, culture.
